title: AI-suggested evidenceType always falls within the 22-item enum accepted by confirmAI
steps: Upload a common evidence type (e.g. a SOC 2 report, an access review spreadsheet, a vulnerability scan PDF)
Check the AI-suggested evidenceType on the review page
expectedResult: The suggested evidenceType is always one of the 22 values in the shared ALLOWED_EVIDENCE_TYPES enum used by both the review page and the confirmAI validator — never an out-of-enum free-text value.

title: Quick check: /ai-evidence layout still gates on evidence.read after any recent layout.jsx change
description: Fast regression sanity check for the CP-1 permission-gating fix — not the full RBAC audit, just a quick confirm the gate is still wired after any touch to layout.jsx.
steps: As a user without evidence.read, hit /ai-evidence/upload directly
expectedResult: Access is still denied/redirected — the PermissionGate wrapper has not been removed or weakened.

title: Quick check: 50MB client-side file-size limit message still reads 'Maximum file size is 50MB' after any AIUploadInterface.jsx edit
steps: Attempt to drop a file larger than 50MB into the AI Evidence dropzone
expectedResult: The toast/error still reads 'Maximum file size is 50MB' (or an intentionally updated equivalent) and the file is not uploaded.

title: Quick check: uploading a plain .txt file still flows through AI extraction to the review page without crashing
expectedResult: The review page loads without a client-side exception, even if AI suggestions for a plain-text file are sparse or low-confidence.
